description: Curated MITRE ATT&CK knowledge base for the deterministic offline triage fallback of the SOC anomaly detector (used when the local LLM is unavailable).

techniques.narrative_template: The process lineage {parent_name} -> {child_name} on {host} executed PowerShell ('{cmd}') for {entity}; encoded command lines, staged downloads via Invoke-Expression/DownloadString or AMSI bypass patterns are characteristic of {actor}.
containment_steps: Isolate host {host} from the network and suspend non-essential services for {entity}.
Terminate the PowerShell process tree: review process="powershell.exe" descendants of {parent_name} for this session (anomaly_id: {anomaly_id}).
Remove staged artifacts: check C:\\Windows\\Temp, %TEMP%, and the user Downloads/AppData folders for files written in the last 24 hours.
Check execution policy and script allowlists: Get-ExecutionPolicy must not be bypassed in production; enable logging of PowerShell command lines (ModuleLogging/ScriptBlockLogging).
Triage with SIEM: search process="powershell" AND host="{host}" AND user="{user}".
hunting_queries: search: process="powershell.exe" AND host="{host}" AND user="{user}"
search: command_line contains "-enc" OR command_line contains "DownloadString"

techniques.narrative_template: The parent process {parent_name} on {host} spawned {child_name} ('{cmd}') running a Unix shell for {entity}; scripted execution via pipes, downloads or cron patterns matches {actor}.
containment_steps: Isolate {host} and terminate anomalous shell sessions for {entity}.
Check cron tables and systemd timers for new/modified entries (anomaly_id: {anomaly_id}).
Search /etc/cron.d, /var/spool/cron, and /etc/systemd/system for artifacts written in the last 24 hours.
Audit home directory and /tmp for new executable scripts.
Search SIEM: process="bash" AND host="{host}".
hunting_queries: search: process="bash" AND command_line="-c" AND host="{host}"

techniques.narrative_template: A remote transfer was observed from {parent_name} on {host} for {entity} ('{cmd}'); the source or staging path pattern matches {actor}.
containment_steps: Block the source endpoint: firewall rules for {host}; review egress destinations (source_ip={source_ip}).
Quarantine files in /tmp, $HOME, /var/tmp written since the alert (anomaly_id: {anomaly_id}).
Search for unexpected binaries in PATH directories and application folders.
Triage: search: destination_ip="{destination_ip}" AND process="*curl*" AND host="{host}".
hunting_queries: search: command_line contains "*| sh" OR command_line contains "| bash"

techniques.narrative_template: {parent_name} on {host} executed {child_name} ('{cmd}') to dump credentials for {entity}; process lineage or tool fingerprint matches {actor}.
containment_steps: Isolate {host} immediately — disable network access for {entity}.
Rotate all credentials and reset passwords used on or targeting {host}.
Audit logon sessions: review Event 4624 (success) and 4768/4769 (kerberos) events.
Triage: search process="hashcat" OR process="john" OR process="mimikatas" AND host="{host}".
hunting_queries: search: process="hashcat" OR process="john" OR process="mimikatas"

techniques.narrative_template: Repeated authentication failures for {entity} (anomaly_id: {anomaly_id}) at {host}; the pattern of many accounts/ports with common passwords matches {actor}.
containment_steps: Block the source IPs at the firewall: {source_ip} and surrounding range.
Check and rotate weak credentials for {entity}.
Review account lockouts: enable and verify multi-factor authentication where applicable.
Triage: search action="failure" AND user="{entity}"
hunting_queries: search: action="failure" AND user="{user}" AND host="{host}"
search: failed auth attempts > 15 per minute for host="{host}"

techniques.narrative_template: {parent_name} on {host} attempted to authenticate {entity} with a batch of credential pairs ('{cmd}'); the volume pattern matches {actor}.
containment_steps: Disable the affected accounts or rotate their passwords immediately.
Monitor subsequent logins (Event 4624) from source_ip={source_ip}.
Check for lateral movement: search action="success" AND source_ip="{source_ip}" AND host!="{host}".

techniques.narrative_template: {entity} initiated an SSH session from {host} to {destination_ip}; the new host pair and non-interactive flags match {actor}.
containment_steps: Review authorized_keys for {entity} on {destination_ip}.
Enable MFA/pubkey-only logins for {entity}.
Audit source_ip={source_ip} sessions for anomalous command chains.
Triage: search process="ssh" AND destination_ip="{destination_ip}"
hunting_queries: search: process="sshd" AND action="session_opened" AND host="{destination_ip}"

techniques.narrative_template: User {entity} on {host} opened or was prompted to open {cmd}; macro-bearing or obfuscated attachment handling matches {actor}.
containment_steps: Quarantine the document and remove any staged payloads written by the user.
Scan the user's home directory and Downloads for executable artifacts.
Increase mailbox protections: enable ATP/SafeLinks-style scanning.
Triage: search user="{user}" AND file_type in ("docx","docm","xlsx","xlsm","zip")

techniques.narrative_template: An unexpected local account operation for {entity} on {host} ('{cmd}') aligns with {actor}.
containment_steps: Disable newly created local accounts: review /etc/passwd entries created in the last 48 hours.
Enforce central account management (SSSD/LDAP) for interactive logins.
Check for scheduled tasks or services running as the new account.

techniques.narrative_template: Anomalous cloud credential usage on {entity} (host={host}) matches {actor}.
containment_steps: Rotate the affected cloud credentials immediately.
Enable MFA and review IAM roles for privilege escalation.
Search SIEM for successful logins from source_ip={source_ip} in the last 24h.
